items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: They tell me Frank is still living.

ctx.x: I met him before he died. I heard him play one time. Jeremy Christian. Heard me? I don't know him. No, they didn't hear. They had these other Christians. They all played violin and trombone or something like that. Well, Emil I know.
They tell me Frank is still living. Yeah, Frank. Yeah, there's nothing.
I mean the majority of them were on the WP at the time.
